final: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) as rental_payment_total FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), store_averages AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(rental_payment_total) as avg_payment_per_rental FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id), above_avg_rentals AS (SELECT rt.store_id, rt.rental_payment_total, sa.avg_payment_per_rental FROM rental_totals rt JOIN store_averages sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id WHERE rt.rental_payment_total > sa.avg_payment_per_rental) SELECT store_id, SUM(rental_payment_total) as sum_above_avg, AVG(rental_payment_total - avg_payment_per_rental) as avg_excess FROM above_avg_rentals GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
